Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Technical Specifications: Chopping Machine For cutting raw medicinal plants, herbs, roots, stems, leaves, and other botanic al materials into smaller, uniform pieces. The machine facilitates efficient size r eduction, improves handling and processing, and helps prepare raw materials f or subsequent operations such as drying, grinding, powdering, and extraction. It is commonly used in the preparation of Ayurvedic formulations, including Kasha ya, Churna, and other herbal medicines. The machine should be constructed fro m suitable, corrosion-resistant materials, preferably stainless steel, to ensure h ygiene, ease of cleaning, and prevention of cross-contamination between differ ent medicinal ingredients. Type: Heavy-duty chopping machine suitable for processing medicinal plants an d raw herbal materials. Capacity: Minimum 50 kg/hour. Motor Power: 10 HP. Feed Material Size: 300 × 40 mm.

Material of Construction (Contact Parts): Stainless Steel (SS 304 preferred). Mounting: Machine shall be provided with anti-vibration mounts. Performance: The machine shall ensure efficient, uniform chopping of the feed material. Safety: Appropriate safety guards shall be provided for all moving and cutting p arts. Electrical System: Suitable electrical controls and overload protection shall be p rovided. Criteria’s: Installation: Complete installation, commissioning, and demonstration of workin g shall be carried out by the supplier. Transportation: Transportation, loading, unloading, and delivery to the purchase r's premises shall be the supplier's responsibility. Warranty: Minimum one-year warranty from the date of successful installation a nd commissioning. After-Sales Service: The supplier shall provide service support within Kerala. Operational Demonstration: The supplier shall demonstrate the machine's perfo rmance at the specified capacity during commissioning. .
